title: Immigration, innovation, and the geography of growth: Lessons from the Age of Mass Migration
title_zh: 移民、创新与增长的地理分布：大规模移民时代的启示
title_primary: 移民、创新与增长的地理分布：大规模移民时代的启示
title_secondary: Immigration, innovation, and the geography of growth: Lessons from the Age of Mass Migration
authors: Costas Arkolakis, Sun Kyoung Lee, Michael Peters
official: 官方在线 2026-09-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: US net migration turned negative in 2025 following a sharp tightening of immigration policies. This column turns to the Age of Mass Migration and the sharp policy reversal of the 1921 and 1924 Quota Acts to examine how immigration shapes long-run growth through its contribution to innovation. The authors find that without the Age of Mass Migration, US GDP per capita would have been 8.2% lower by 1940, while the policy that ended mass migration harmed the US comparatively little. They also demonstrate the importance of geography: the impact of immigration on productivity depends not only on how many arrive and how skilled they are, but also where they settle.
abstract_zh: 2025年，随着移民政策的急剧收紧，美国净移民转为负值。本文回顾大规模移民时代及1921年和1924年《配额法案》引发的政策急转，探讨移民如何通过其对创新的贡献塑造长期增长。作者发现，若无大规模移民时代，到1940年美国人均GDP将低8.2%，而终结大规模移民的政策对美国造成的损害相对较小。他们还证明了地理因素的重要性：移民对生产率的影响不仅取决于抵达人数及其技能水平，还取决于他们的定居地点。

title: DP20519 From Chalkboards to Steam Engines: Early Adoption of Compulsory Schooling, Innovation, and Industrialization
title_zh: 从黑板到蒸汽机：义务教育的早期普及、创新与工业化
title_primary: 从黑板到蒸汽机：义务教育的早期普及、创新与工业化
title_secondary: DP20519 From Chalkboards to Steam Engines: Early Adoption of Compulsory Schooling, Innovation, and Industrialization
authors: Francesco Cinnirella, Elona Harka
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Empirical evidence on the historical role of Compulsory Schooling Laws (CSL) for the spread of mass education is mixed at best. This is also due to the difficulty of identifying exogenous variation in the application of CSL. We exploit an almost unique feature of a CSL in 1877 Italy which was gradually implemented across municipalities based on the teacher to population ratio. This criterion generates a sharp discontinuity which can be exploited to estimate the causal effect of the early implementation of CSL on economic outcomes. Estimates based on a regression discontinuity design show that CSL had a positive long-term effect on innovation and industrial employment. Consistent with the main objective of the reform, CSL had a positive effect on human capital by increasing enrollment rates in technical schools and, more in general, the literacy rate. The results are robust to a series of placebo, falsification and manipulation tests. This study provides important policy implications in favor of the early implementation of CSL to increase the average level of education which, in turns, brings about positive effects on innovation and industrialization.
abstract_zh: 关于义务教育法（CSL）在普及大众教育中的历史作用的实证证据充其量是混杂的。这同样归因于识别CSL实施中外生变异性的困难。我们利用了1877年意大利一项义务教育法的一个近乎独特的特点，该法律根据教师与人口比例在各市镇逐步实施。这一标准产生了明显的断点，可用于估计早期实施CSL对经济结果的因果效应。基于断点回归设计的估计显示，CSL对创新和工业就业产生了积极的长期影响。与改革的主要目标一致，CSL通过提高技术学校入学率和整体识字率，对人力资本产生了积极影响。结果在一系列安慰剂、证伪和操纵测试中均稳健。本研究提供了重要的政策启示，支持早期实施CSL以提高平均教育水平，进而对创新和工业化产生积极影响。

title: Small-Group Interactions Reduce Homophily by Muting Directed Search
title_zh: 小组互动通过抑制定向搜索减少同质性
title_primary: 小组互动通过抑制定向搜索减少同质性
title_secondary: Small-Group Interactions Reduce Homophily by Muting Directed Search
authors: Andrea Galeotti, Reem Qamar, Adam Szeidl
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how the quasi-random assignment of MBA students to different peer groups shapes their homophily by gender and ethnicity. We show that students form substantially more cross-trait friendships within small groups than in the broader MBA cohort. We then decompose homophily into the contributions of peer-group composition, preferences, and directed search. Directed search, in which students approach peers with particular characteristics, can substantially amplify even weak preferences for same-trait friends. Survey evidence indicates only weak same-trait preferences but strong same-trait bias in approach decisions. Consistent with this pattern, structural estimates imply that directed search accounts for much of overall homophily. This result helps explain why homophily is lower in small groups, where directed search is muted, and suggests that homophily can be reduced through peer-group design.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了MBA学生被准随机分配到不同同伴群体如何塑造其基于性别和种族的同质性。我们表明，学生在小群体内形成的跨特质友谊显著多于在更广泛的MBA群体中。随后，我们将同质性分解为同伴群体构成、偏好和定向搜索的贡献。定向搜索，即学生主动接触具有特定特征的同伴，即使对同特质朋友的偏好较弱，也能大幅放大这种偏好。调查证据显示，同特质偏好仅较弱，但在接触决策中存在强烈的同特质偏见。与此模式一致，结构估计表明，定向搜索解释了整体同质性的大部分。这一结果有助于解释为何在小群体中同质性较低，因为定向搜索在此受到抑制，并提示通过同伴群体设计可以降低同质性。

title: Deceptive Science Maps: Organizational Affiliation and Data Manipulation in Alzheimer's Research
title_zh: 欺骗性科学地图：阿尔茨海默病研究中的组织隶属关系与数据操纵
title_primary: 欺骗性科学地图：阿尔茨海默病研究中的组织隶属关系与数据操纵
title_secondary: Deceptive Science Maps: Organizational Affiliation and Data Manipulation in Alzheimer's Research
authors: Matteo Tranchero, Christian Fons-Rosen, Lee Fleming
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Does corporate authorship increase or decrease deceptive conduct in science? Commercial interests are often viewed as a threat to scientific integrity. Yet when firms build on their science in downstream innovation, fraudulent findings can derail costly development, creating private incentives to produce reliable evidence. We test this logic in Alzheimer’s research, using inappropriate image duplication as an observable marker of deceptive conduct. Combining AI-based detection with manual validation, we document a rising incidence of data manipulation. Such cases are nearly absent in corporate-authored papers and less frequent in academic-industry collaborations, but only when firms exercise meaningful control over the production of evidence. The reduction in problematic duplications is largest when firms are likely to build on the results and in settings where deceptive conduct is more prevalent. However, this difference disappears when research concerns drugs already commercialized by the authoring firm. These findings recast the role of commercial interests in science: they can undermine integrity when legitimating existing products, but strengthen it when firms need solid evidence to build on.
abstract_zh: 企业作者身份是增加还是减少了科学中的欺骗行为？商业利益常被视为对科学诚信的威胁。然而，当企业在下游创新中依托自身科研成果时，欺诈性发现可能使昂贵的研发进程偏离轨道，从而产生私人激励去产出可靠的证据。我们在阿尔茨海默病研究中检验了这一逻辑，以不当图像重复作为欺骗行为的可观察标记。结合基于人工智能的检测与人工验证，我们记录了数据操纵现象日益增多的趋势。此类情况在企业作者署名的论文中几乎不存在，在学术-产业合作中亦较少出现，但前提是企业对证据生产过程施加了实质性控制。当企业很可能基于研究结果进行后续开发，以及欺骗行为更为普遍的背景下，问题性重复的减少最为显著。然而，当研究涉及作者企业已商业化的药物时，这一差异消失。这些发现重新诠释了商业利益在科学中的作用：当用于为现有产品正名时，商业利益可能损害诚信；但当企业需要可靠证据以支撑后续开发时，商业利益则能强化诚信。

title: When No Bad Deed Goes Punished: Relational Contracting in Ghana and the UK
title_zh: 当恶行未受惩罚时：加纳与英国的关系契约
title_primary: 当恶行未受惩罚时：加纳与英国的关系契约
title_secondary: When No Bad Deed Goes Punished: Relational Contracting in Ghana and the UK
authors: Elwyn Davies, M. Fafchamps
official: 官方在线 2018-07-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Experiment evidence to date indicates that subjects follow a trigger strategy in finitely repeated games: they punish bad contractual performance by reducing future offers and the threat of punishment disciplines opportunistic breach. This behavior contradicts standard game theory predictions. We conduct a repeated prisoner’s dilemma (PD) game experiment with university students in Ghana and the UK. The experiment is framed as an employment contract. Each period the employer makes a irrevocable wage offer to the worker who then chooses an effort level. UK subjects use a trigger strategy to discipline workers, in line with previous experiments: wage offers reward high effort and punish low effort in the past; this induces workers to choose high effort; and gains from trade are shared between workers and employers. We find no such evidence with Ghana subjects: employers seldom reduce wage offers after low effort and, if they do, workers respond by lowering effort; employer often reduce wages after high effort; and employers earn a zero payoff on average. Introducing competition or reputation does not significantly improve workers’ effort. We conclude that the use of trigger strategies in repeated labor transactions is not a universally shared heuristic. © 2021 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. abstract_zh: 迄今为止的实验证据表明，在有限重复博弈中，受试者遵循触发策略：他们通过减少未来的出价来惩罚不良的合同履行，而惩罚的威胁则约束了机会主义的违约行为。这一行为与标准博弈论的预测相悖。我们在加纳和英国的大学学生中进行了重复囚徒困境（PD）博弈实验。实验被设定为雇佣合同的框架。每个时期，雇主向工人提出不可撤销的工资报价，工人随后选择努力水平。英国受试者使用触发策略来约束工人，这与之前的实验一致：工资报价奖励过去的高努力并惩罚低努力；这促使工人选择高努力；贸易收益在工人和雇主之间共享。然而，我们在加纳受试者中未发现此类证据：雇主在工人低努力后很少降低工资报价，即便降低，工人也会以降低努力作为回应；雇主经常在高努力后降低工资；且雇主平均获得零收益。引入竞争或声誉并未显著改善工人的努力水平。我们得出结论，在重复劳动交易中使用触发策略并非普遍共享的启发式方法。© 2021 Elsevier B.V. 保留所有权利。我们感谢Johannes Abeler、Alan Beggs、Douglas Bernheim、Stefano Caria、Johannes Haushofer、Rocco Macchiavello、Karine Marazyan、Fola Malomo、Muriel Niederle、Simon Quinn、Christopher Roth、Yogita Shamdasani、Hannah Uckat、Marc Witte，以及牛津企业与发展研究小组、斯坦福行为与实验午餐会、CSAE-iiG会议、斯坦福发展研讨会、CSAE研究研讨会、巴黎DIAL会议、世界银行贫困与应用微观研讨会、NEUDC、PacDev和SEEDEC的参与者提供的宝贵意见。非常感谢Václav T ̌ehle和Martin Černý出色的研究协助，以及Andrew Kerr和Denise Gray在本实验试运行期间的帮助。此外，我们感谢Moses Awoonor-Williams在后勤方面的协助，以及我们在当地的实地团队，特别是Eric Agyekum和Bismark Owusu Tetteh Nortey。本研究属于一项更广泛的加纳创业研究的一部分，由英国国际发展部（DFID）资助[资助号GB-1-113580]，作为iiG研究项目的一部分，旨在研究如何改善非洲和南亚有利于穷人的增长的制度。Elwyn Davies感谢经济与社会研究理事会（ESRC）的额外资助[资助号ES/J500112/1]。本研究的IRB批准由牛津大学中央大学研究伦理委员会获得。本文表达的观点、解释和结论完全属于作者本人，不代表DFID、国际复兴开发银行/世界银行及其附属组织的观点，也不代表世界银行执行董事或其代表的政府的观点。∗ 通讯作者。电子邮箱：edavies@worldbank.org (E. title: Supplemental Medicare Insurance Coverage for Older Adults with Probable Dementia
title_zh: 老年人可能痴呆症补充医疗保险覆盖研究
title_primary: 老年人可能痴呆症补充医疗保险覆盖研究
title_secondary: Supplemental Medicare Insurance Coverage for Older Adults with Probable Dementia
authors: Melissa McInerney, Lorena Moreno, Jennifer M. Mellor
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this paper, we compare supplemental Medicare insurance coverage among people with probable dementia (PWPD) and matched controls, before and after onset. This retrospective secondary data analysis of insurance coverage changes using propensity score weights and the 2000-2016 Health and Retirement Study (HRS). The sample consists of 3,001 Medicare-enrolled adults age 65 and older with PWPD, and 14,055 controls. Probable dementia is assessed with the Langa-Weir approach and interviewer assessments for proxy interviews. Four years before onset, PWPD become more likely to have Medicare without supplemental coverage (2.97 percentage points; p=0.0016) than matched controls. This reflects the net effect of PWPD being less likely to have Medicare Advantage or traditional Medicare with supplemental coverage, and more likely to have Medicaid. Two years before onset, PWPD were more likely to be Medicaid-eligible (4.95 percentage points, p<0.001), but take-up rates were comparable. Enrollment assistance may improve supplemental coverage for PWPD around dementia onset, potentially increasing financial access to care.
abstract_zh: 本文对比了可能患有痴呆症（PWPD）人群与匹配对照组在发病前后补充医疗保险覆盖情况。本研究利用倾向性评分加权及2000-2016年健康与退休研究（HRS）数据，进行回顾性二次数据分析。样本包括3，001名65岁及以上已参保Medicare的PWPD成年人，以及14，055名对照组。可能痴呆症通过Langa-Weir方法及代理访谈中的访员评估进行判定。在发病前四年，PWPD相较于匹配对照组，更可能仅拥有Medicare而无补充保险（差异2.97个百分点；p=0.0016）。这反映了PWPD拥有Medicare Advantage或传统Medicare附带补充保险的可能性较低，而拥有Medicaid的可能性较高的净效应。发病前两年，PWPD符合Medicaid资格的可能性更高（差异4.95个百分点，p<0.001），但参保率相当。在痴呆症发病前后，注册援助可能改善PWPD的补充保险覆盖，从而可能增加其获得医疗服务的财务可及性。

title: Aid and armed actors: Collaboration and aid delivery in the DRC
title_zh: 援助与武装行为体：刚果民主共和国中的合作与援助交付
title_primary: 援助与武装行为体：刚果民主共和国中的合作与援助交付
title_secondary: Aid and armed actors: Collaboration and aid delivery in the DRC
authors: Haley Swedlund, Marie-Eve Desrosiers, Joshua Fawcett Weiner, Pierre Sosthène Kambidi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In conflict-affected contexts, the presence of armed actors—including state security forces, international peacekeeping missions, and non-state armed groups—means that aid organisations may need to cooperate with these actors to deliver foreign aid. Yet the conditions under which this cooperation happens remain underspecified. In this article, we use novel mixed methods data from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to study these conditions. Building on qualitative interviews with Kinshasa-based aid practitioners, as well as a survey and survey experiment with Congolese provincial-level aid workers, we provide systematic evidence of the conditions under which humanitarian and development aid workers are more or less likely to collaborate with different types of armed actors across different regions of the country. We test three hypotheses: the type of armed actor, the visibility of cooperation, and the proximity to conflict. Our findings suggest that the type of armed actor and the proximity of the aid workers to conflict matter most. The public visibility of their collaboration is less important than anticipated. For those at the forefront of aid delivery, it is primarily the concrete realities and day-to-day interactions that appear to shape decision-making and behavior.
abstract_zh: 在冲突影响的环境中，武装行为体的存在——包括国家安保力量、国际维和任务及非国家武装团体——意味着援助组织可能需要与这些行为体合作以提供外国援助。然而，这种合作发生的条件仍未得到充分明确。本文利用来自刚果民主共和国（DRC）的新型混合方法数据来研究这些条件。基于对金沙萨援助从业者的定性访谈，以及对刚果省级援助工作者的调查和调查实验，我们提供了系统性证据，说明人道主义和发展援助工作者在不同地区与不同类型武装行为体合作的可能性条件。我们检验了三个假设：武装行为体的类型、合作的可见性以及与冲突的接近程度。我们的发现表明，武装行为体的类型和援助工作者与冲突的接近程度最为关键。他们合作的公开可见性不如预期重要。对于处于援助交付前线的人员而言，主要是具体的现实情况和日常互动塑造了决策和行为。

title: Spatially coordinated conservation auctions under imperfect information about ecological spillovers
title_zh: 不完全信息下考虑生态溢出效应的空间协调保护拍卖
title_primary: 不完全信息下考虑生态溢出效应的空间协调保护拍卖
title_secondary: Spatially coordinated conservation auctions under imperfect information about ecological spillovers
authors: Zhaoyang Liu, Xiaojun Yang, Paul R Armsworth, Nick Hanley
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Increasing attention is being paid to the design of economic incentives for conservation on private land to encourage spatial coordination. We investigate the effects of using incorrect information on the ecological benefits of spatial coordination in the design of a conservation auction, using a framed field experiment with real farmers as participants. We find that auction performance can be substantially weakened if the parameters adopted are ‘wrong enough’ to change which farms are prioritized for enrolment in a conservation contract. Parameters that under-estimate the true coordination benefits are less damaging to policy performance than those which over-estimate these benefits.
abstract_zh: 私人土地保护的经济激励设计正日益受到关注，以促进空间协调。我们通过一项以真实农民为参与者的框架实地实验，研究了在保护拍卖设计中采用关于空间协调生态效益的错误信息所产生的影响。研究发现，如果采用的参数“错误程度足够大”，以至于改变了保护合同优先纳入的农场排序，拍卖绩效可能会显著削弱。低估真实协调效益的参数对政策绩效的损害小于高估这些效益的参数。

title: Agri‐Food Policymaking in More Turbulent Times: Reflections at the Centenary of the Agricultural Economics Society
title_zh: 动荡时期中的农业食品政策制定：农业经济学学会百年反思

authors: Alan Matthews
official: 官方在线 2026-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Agricultural and food policy is increasingly shaped by geopolitical instability, ecological constraints, technological disruption, political polarisation and declining trust in expertise. At the same time, calls for food system transformation have gained prominence as evidence accumulates on the environmental, health and social shortcomings of current food systems. Yet reform has frequently stalled despite extensive scientific analysis and broad recognition of the need for change. This paper examines why. After reviewing some traditional explanations for policy persistence, the paper introduces the concept of policy ontologies: underlying ways of understanding what the food system is, how it functions, what it is ultimately for and how change occurs. Three ideal‐type ontologies are identified: a productivity ontology, a power‐focused ontology and an ecological ontology. These ontologies shape the definition of policy problems and the selection of preferred policy responses, helping to explain why stakeholders often appear to talk past one another. As the Society begins its second century in a more turbulent and contested policy environment, the profession's central role remains the production of rigorous evidence. That contribution will be strengthened by a greater awareness of the different ways in which food systems are understood and of how these perspectives shape both policy debates and the interpretation of evidence. Recognising these underlying assumptions can help agricultural economists contribute more effectively to policy debate as honest brokers of policy alternatives.
abstract_zh: 农业与食品政策日益受到地缘政治不稳定、生态约束、技术颠覆、政治极化以及对专业知识信任度下降的影响。与此同时，随着关于当前食品体系在环境、健康和社会方面缺陷的证据不断积累，要求食品体系转型的呼声日益高涨。然而，尽管有广泛的科学分析和变革必要性的普遍共识，改革却常常陷入停滞。本文探讨了其中的原因。在回顾了关于政策持续性的传统解释之后，本文引入了政策本体论的概念：即对食品体系是什么、如何运作、其最终目的以及变革如何发生的基本理解方式。本文识别出三种理想类型的本体论：生产力本体论、权力聚焦本体论和生态本体论。这些本体论塑造了政策问题的定义和首选政策响应的选择，有助于解释为何利益相关者常常看似在自说自话。随着学会在一个更加动荡和充满争议的政策环境中开启其第二个世纪，本专业的核心角色仍然是提供严谨的证据。通过增强对食品体系不同理解方式以及这些视角如何影响政策辩论和证据解读的认识，这一贡献将得到加强。认识到这些潜在的假设，有助于农业经济学家作为政策替代方案的诚实中间人，更有效地为政策辩论做出贡献。

title: Tying Incentives to Information: Diagnosis-Contingent Contracts and Biased Beliefs in Healthcare

title_primary: 将激励与信息挂钩：基于诊断的合同与医疗中的认知偏差
title_secondary: Tying Incentives to Information: Diagnosis-Contingent Contracts and Biased Beliefs in Healthcare
authors: Maria Dieci, Paul Gertler, Jonathan T. Kolstad, Carlos Paramo
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Unnecessary treatment reflects a gap between what patients believe about their health and their true condition; people often seek and consume care for diseases they suspect, but do not know that actually have. The value a patient places on testing therefore depends on their priors about being sick, and when those beliefs are biased, the resulting testing rate might be sub-optimal and leave welfare on the table. We study diagnosis-contingent incentive contracts, which tie treatment incentives to diagnostic results. For malaria, the contract subsidizes rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) and antimalarials (ACTs) only for patients who test positive. In a cluster-randomized experiment across 140 Kenyan pharmacies, both patient subsidies and provider incentives roughly tripled testing and sharply reduced unnecessary ACT purchases among test-negative patients, working through distinct channels: patient subsidies through lower prices, provider incentives through information and advice. A model of patient choice implies these contracts raise social welfare well above their cost. Estimating the model structurally, we find that because patients substantially overestimate their infection risk, loading incentives onto diagnosis-contingent treatment discounts delivers four times the welfare gains of free testing programs.
abstract_zh: 不必要的治疗反映了患者对自身健康状况的认知与其真实状况之间的差距；人们常常因怀疑自己患有某种疾病而寻求并接受医疗服务，但实际上并不知晓自己是否真的患病。因此，患者对检测的重视程度取决于其对患病可能性的先验信念，而当这些信念存在偏差时，由此产生的检测率可能并非最优，从而造成福利损失。我们研究了与诊断结果挂钩的激励合同，即将治疗激励与诊断结果相关联。针对疟疾，该合同仅对检测呈阳性的患者补贴快速诊断测试（RDTs）和青蒿素联合疗法（ACTs）。在一项覆盖肯尼亚140家药店的整群随机实验中，患者补贴和提供者激励均使检测率大约提高了两倍，并显著减少了检测阴性患者中不必要的ACT购买，二者通过不同渠道发挥作用：患者补贴通过降低价格，提供者激励则通过信息和建议。患者选择模型表明，这些合同带来的社会福利提升远超其成本。通过对模型进行结构化估计，我们发现，由于患者大幅高估其感染风险，将激励加载到基于诊断结果的治疗折扣上，其福利收益是免费检测项目的四倍。

abstract: This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了信息设计对美国海上油气租赁拍卖中拍卖方收益的影响。在拍卖结束后，中标者需决定是否对拍卖地块进行勘探，并须按其生产价值向政府支付特许权使用费。我首先发现，勘探率与公开观察到的未中标报价之间存在正相关关系。这表明，中标者利用竞争对手的报价来推断其关于地块潜力的私人信息。随后，我刻画了当拍卖方设计并承诺如何向中标者披露未中标报价信息时的均衡投标策略。反事实分析表明，替代性的报价披露政策能够显著提高拍卖方收益。

Respondents might often misreport sensitive attitudes and behaviors to appear more socially acceptable. authors: Jarkko Harju, Ida Kankaanranta, Kaisa Kotakorpi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the effects of taxi market deregulation in Finland, which removed price controls and lowered barriers to entry. The reform led to a surge in firm entry and a modest increase in exit, indicating substantial changes in market structure. Average taxi prices increased slightly according to price indices, while monthly firm-level reported sales and VAT declined by over 10 percent. Operating costs and mileage remained largely unchanged, suggesting limited demand responses. These findings point to increased tax evasion following deregulation. Consistent with this interpretation, we document a small rise in property crime, with no effects on other criminal offenses.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了芬兰出租车市场放松管制的影响，该改革取消了价格控制并降低了市场准入门槛。改革导致企业大量进入市场，退出数量略有增加，表明市场结构发生了显著变化。根据价格指数，出租车平均价格小幅上涨，而企业月度报告销售额和增值税下降了超过10%。运营成本和行驶里程基本保持不变，表明需求反应有限。这些发现表明放松管制后逃税行为有所增加。与这一解释一致，我们记录了财产犯罪的小幅上升，而对其他刑事犯罪没有影响。

title: Financial Sanctions and the Global Payments Network
title_zh: 金融制裁与全球支付网络
title_primary: 金融制裁与全球支付网络
title_secondary: Financial Sanctions and the Global Payments Network
authors: Gregor Matvos, Brent Neiman
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Financial sanctions are widely viewed as a powerful tool of economic statecraft, yet direct evidence on their effects remains limited. We study how sanctions affect access to global payment networks using data on correspondent banking relationships, which link banks across countries and currencies to enable cross-border transactions. We first show that the dollar and euro networks offer the broadest global connectivity, supported by a small number of key hubs in the U.S. and Europe. Sanctions that restrict access to these hubs are therefore potentially powerful. We then show how financial sanctions imposed during 2021-2025 – a period of rapid growth in sanctions – reduced targeted banks' access to major-currency networks by severing correspondent relationships. Sanctioned institutions often retained access but only through longer, indirect, and more fragile chains of intermediaries. Finally, in countries where sanctions expanded sharply, non-sanctioned banks also lost connectivity to Western networks, likely reflecting de-risking. These banks reoriented toward alternatives, particularly the Chinese yuan. Outside these heavily sanctioned economies, shifts away from the dollar and toward the yuan remain minimal on average.
abstract_zh: 金融制裁被广泛视为经济治国方略的有力工具，但其影响的直接证据仍然有限。我们利用代理行关系数据研究制裁如何影响全球支付网络的接入——这些关系将不同国家和货币的银行连接起来，以实现跨境交易。我们首先发现，美元和欧元网络提供了最广泛的全球连通性，这得益于美国和欧洲少数关键枢纽的支持。因此，限制这些枢纽接入的制裁具有潜在强大效力。随后，我们展示了2021-2025年间（制裁快速扩张时期）实施的金融制裁如何通过切断代理行关系，削弱目标银行对主要货币网络的接入。受制裁机构往往仍能保留接入渠道，但只能通过更长、间接且更脆弱的中间链条实现。最后，在制裁急剧扩大的国家，未受制裁的银行也失去了与西方网络的连通性，这很可能反映了去风险化行为。这些银行转向替代方案，尤其是人民币。而在这些受严重制裁的经济体之外，从美元转向人民币的总体变化仍微乎其微。

abstract: We study companies' decisions about holding annual shareholder meetings online during the Covid pandemic and returning to traditional in-person meetings post-pandemic. Among S&P 1500 companies, the frequency of virtual meetings shot up from less than 10% to more than 80% in the first year of the pandemic, with only gradual reversion to in-person meetings since then. In-person meetings are more likely for companies that have Republican majority boards and Republican CEOs, and for companies with headquarters located in jurisdictions that vote Republican. We find little evidence that Republican-led firms have unusually adverse experiences with virtual meetings, and we therefore conclude that their preference for in-person annual meetings aligns with conservative political opposition to other Covid-era regulations that restricted public gatherings and personal contact.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了新冠疫情期间公司决定在线举行年度股东大会，以及疫情后回归传统线下会议的现象。在标普1500指数公司中，虚拟会议的频率在疫情第一年从不足10%飙升至超过80%，此后仅逐步回归线下会议。线下会议更可能出现在董事会中共和党占多数、首席执行官为共和党人，以及总部位于投票支持共和党地区的公司。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明共和党领导的公司因虚拟会议而遭遇异常不利的经历，因此我们得出结论，他们偏好线下年度会议与保守派政治立场反对其他疫情期间限制公众集会和人际接触的规定相一致。

title: Explaining the Historical Rise and Recent Decline in Social Security Disability Insurance Enrollment
title_zh: 解释社会保障残疾保险参保率的历史上升与近期下降
title_primary: 解释社会保障残疾保险参保率的历史上升与近期下降
title_secondary: Explaining the Historical Rise and Recent Decline in Social Security Disability Insurance Enrollment
authors: Manasi Deshpande, Maxwell Kellogg, Magne Mogstad, Kuan-Ju Tseng
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: After substantial growth in the 1990s and 2000s, enrollment in the U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) program has been declining since 2013. We use detailed administrative data to quantify the contributions of various factors to trends in SSDI enrollment, focusing especially on the decline in the 2010s. A statistical decomposition suggests that the vast majority of the decline in SSDI enrollment since 2013 is attributable to declines in application rates—and, to a lesser extent, award rates—within demographic groups. There is very little contribution from changes over time in demographic characteristics, eligibility, or exit from SSDI. The decline in SSDI enrollment rates is disproportionately driven by low-to-middle-skilled men who, over time, have become less likely to apply for SSDI and more likely to work. Consistent with this descriptive evidence, we present results from a causal analysis suggesting that improved labor market opportunity for less-skilled men is a key explanation for the decline in SSDI enrollment. We also investigate several other popular hypotheses for the decline in SSDI applications, including lower award rates at the appeals level, and find evidence at odds with them.
abstract_zh: 在1990年代和2000年代经历了显著增长后，美国社会保障残疾保险（SSDI）项目的参保人数自2013年起持续下降。我们利用详细的行政数据量化了各因素对SSDI参保趋势的贡献，重点关注2010年代的下降趋势。统计分解表明，2013年以来SSDI参保人数的下降绝大部分可归因于各人口群体内申请率的下降（以及较小程度上的批准率下降）。人口特征、资格条件或退出SSDI的时序变化对下降趋势的贡献微乎其微。SSDI参保率的下降主要由中低技能男性群体驱动——随着时间的推移，该群体申请SSDI的可能性降低，而就业可能性上升。与这一描述性证据一致，我们通过因果分析发现，低技能男性劳动力市场机会的改善是解释SSDI参保率下降的关键因素。我们还检验了其他几种关于SSDI申请下降的流行假说（包括上诉阶段批准率降低），但发现证据与之相悖。

abstract: Using a panel of 157 countries over the period 2000–2022, we estimate time-varying coefficients of government spending cyclicality and examine whether independent fiscal institutions help reduce this cyclicality. Our findings indicate that the design features of independent fiscal institutions play a crucial role. Institutions with stronger mandates, broader responsibilities, greater independence, adequate resources, and effective communication frameworks are associated with more countercyclical fiscal policy.
abstract_zh: 利用2000年至2022年间157个国家的面板数据，我们估计了政府支出周期性的时变系数，并考察独立财政机构是否有助于降低这种周期性。研究结果显示，独立财政机构的设计特征至关重要。拥有更强授权、更广泛职责、更高独立性、充足资源及有效沟通框架的机构，与更具逆周期性的财政政策相关联。

official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Research based on farmer surveys is a cornerstone of agricultural economics. Farmer surveys provide unique insights into behavioural variables—such as values, motivations, attitudes, behaviours, and preferences—that are unavailable in secondary datasets. However, the decline in farm numbers across most European countries, combined with a growing number of surveys, is posing a threat to farmer survey research. This paper synthesises current practices in farmer surveys in the Netherlands, Slovenia, and Sweden. Our approach is meta‐scientific, drawing on a survey aimed at researchers responsible for 34 farmer surveys conducted between January 2019 and August 2024. This analysis is complemented by a document analysis and critical reflection workshops. We identify three key challenges: (i) limited consistency and standardisation of socio‐economic survey questions, (ii) long surveys, which are associated with high attrition and low response rates, and (iii) low adoption of open science practices. To address these challenges, we propose a set of best practices to enhance the transparency, comparability, standardisation, and reusability of farmer survey data. These best practices aim to strengthen the quality of survey‐based research in agricultural economics and ensure that farmer surveys continue to support evidence‐based policymaking.
abstract_zh: 摘要 基于农户调查的研究是农业经济学的基石。农户调查提供了关于行为变量（如价值观、动机、态度、行为和偏好）的独特见解，这些变量在二手数据集中无法获得。然而，大多数欧洲国家农户数量的下降，加之调查数量的不断增加，正对农户调查研究构成威胁。本文综合了荷兰、斯洛文尼亚和瑞典农户调查的当前实践。我们的方法具有元科学性质，依托一项针对2019年1月至2024年8月期间负责34项农户调查的研究人员的调查。该分析辅以文献分析和批判性反思研讨会。我们识别出三个关键挑战：（i）社会经济调查问题的一致性和标准化程度有限，（ii）调查篇幅过长，导致高流失率和低回复率，以及（iii）开放科学实践的采用率较低。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一套最佳实践，以增强农户调查数据的透明度、可比性、标准化和可重用性。这些最佳实践旨在加强农业经济学中基于调查的研究质量，并确保农户调查继续支持循证政策制定。

title: Two-faced on facebook: Ad tailoring in U.S. house campaigns

title_primary: 脸谱网上的两面性：美国众议院竞选中的广告定制
title_secondary: Two-faced on facebook: Ad tailoring in U.S. house campaigns
authors: Sarah Waldfogel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Congressional candidates simultaneously seek votes from local residents and money from partisan potential donors who live across the United States. Ad targeting allows political candidates an inexpensive way not only to reach this dispersed partisan audience but also to deliver messages tailored to donors, whose preferences are more extreme than voters’. Using data on geographically-targeted Facebook ads, I find that the national ads of Democratic and Republican candidates have less issue overlap — and are more extreme — than their local, voter-targeted ads. Candidates’ ability to direct tailored, extreme communication to receptive audiences via targeted ads facilitates divergent political speech.
abstract_zh: 国会议员候选人在争取本地居民选票的同时，也寻求来自全美各地党派潜在捐赠者的资金支持。广告定向投放为政治候选人提供了一种低成本的方式，不仅能够触达分散的党派受众，还能向偏好比选民更为极端的捐赠者传递定制化信息。利用地理定向的Facebook广告数据，我发现民主党和共和党候选人的全国性广告在议题重叠度上低于其面向本地选民的广告，且内容更为极端。候选人通过定向广告向接受度高的受众传达定制化、极端化的政治言论，这一能力促进了政治话语的分化。
